title: The Heart of the Iron Woodcutter

slides.text: Unit Nine was forged in the foundries of the Iron King for a single purpose: to march into the Whispering Woods and burn every ancient tree to ash. Armed with a furnace in his brass chest and axes for hands, he felled ten thousand oaks over three centuries, until the forest was nothing but a desert of grey cinders and rusted gears.

Forty years after the war ended and the King's empire crumbled to dust, a scavenger hunting for scrap metal pried open the grate of Unit Nine's chest, expecting to find cold coal and a dead clockwork core. The giant automaton stood motionless in the acid rain, his iron joints fused with moss so he could never swing his axes again.

Inside the hollow chamber where his furnace had once roared, the scavenger found a single, glowing ember kept carefully damped—just warm enough to ward off the frost. Curled around that tiny heat, rooted in a handful of dark soil the machine had carried for three hundred miles, grew the last silver-leaf sapling in the world, its branches blooming through his ribs.
